title: Inconsistent project, session and status rails
observed: The integration checkpoint uses project/session/status text rails around 60/56/44dp.
impact: Eye movement zigzags across the three pieces of one project context.
proposal: Use 16dp outer padding, 32dp leading slot and 12dp gap for a 60dp text rail.
verification: Pinned Shorebird Flutter 3.47.2: 63 serial focused tests passed across workspace_hierarchy, return_brief_widget, projects_screen, session_needs_you and the eight-case capture fixture. title: Duplicate New session actions in empty Workspace
observed: ProductInlineEmpty and the fixed bottom action both offer New session; the fixed button also nests redundant semantics.
impact: One simple start decision has two competing controls, especially prominent when inventory is empty.
proposal: Keep one fixed accessible New session button and a descriptive empty state.

title: Session names truncate at one line
observed: Workspace session titles have maxLines: 1, including at 2x text.
impact: Returning developers lose distinguishing task words even when the page has spare space.
proposal: Allow two title lines and keep tap-to-resume behavior unchanged.

title: Bottom action edge and gap disagree with navigation
observed: The visible button starts 18dp from the edge because 12dp outer and 6dp inner paddings stack; button-to-dock gap is 24dp.
impact: Two stacked control regions consume space without a shared edge.
proposal: Use 16dp visible action edge, no invisible 6dp tray, and 6dp bottom spacing to combine with the shell 6dp top gap.

title: Session metadata competes with the task name
observed: Relative time and status inherit ListTile subtitle typography while names are limited to one line.
impact: Metadata receives space and emphasis that should aid task recognition.
proposal: Use bodySmall supporting metadata while retaining colored blocker emphasis and full session title semantics.

title: List entrance choreography lacks runtime scroll evidence
observed: Recent sessions use EntranceReveal with staggered index-based entry.
impact: Newly materialized rows may appear to arrive after scrolling; no frame evidence confirms this here.
proposal: Render recent session rows immediately, matching other inventory sections; retain shared dock and busy-state motion.
verification: Regression test scrolls 40 sessions away and back and verifies the returning row is immediately rendered without an entrance reveal. Native frame-time measurement remains an integration gate; this does not claim an FPS improvement.

title: Repeated partial-inventory notices compete with sessions
observed: Return brief, recent empty state and footer repeated loaded/incomplete status; partial archive rows added a third loaded count.
impact: One inventory condition dominates the session-first page.
proposal: Keep loading/error/continuation truth in the footer and preserve separate stale/read-state warnings.
verification: Focused English/RTL tests and captures are recorded in the slice evidence; final integration/native checks are separate.

title: Global search and loaded-folder filters imply the same scope
observed: A server-wide title search opens from Recent; folder chips narrow only loaded global results.
impact: Users may mistake loaded matches for complete project history.
proposal: Name every-project title search and label partial summaries and folder filtering as loaded results.
verification: Focused English/RTL tests and captures are recorded in the slice evidence; final integration/native checks are separate.

title: RTL reverses path punctuation and fixed filters clip scaled text
observed: A font-loaded RTL capture paints /work/shop as work/shop/; global filter rows assume 48dp height.
impact: Paths become misleading and filters crowd user-scaled labels.
proposal: Keep path-only values LTR and derive filter height from user text scale.
verification: Focused English/RTL tests and captures are recorded in the slice evidence; final integration/native checks are separate.

title: Unsupported stale form state marks return brief stale
observed: Old forms loading/error flags contribute stale status without checking forms support.
impact: A connection that cannot provide forms reports uncertainty for an irrelevant feature.
proposal: Gate form stale state on its capability while preserving supported request failures.
verification: Focused English/RTL tests and captures are recorded in the slice evidence; final integration/native checks are separate.
